node.statement: Parameter monotonicity for the registered def-epsilon-cstar-algebra: if 0 <= alpha <= beta and (calX,J,bold-dot,dagger) satisfies every exact-unit alpha-C*-algebra axiom, then it satisfies every exact-unit beta-C*-algebra axiom. Indeed, ||x bold-dot y|| <= (1+alpha)||x||||y|| <= (1+beta)||x||||y||; the associator bound alpha||x||||y||||z|| is at most beta||x||||y||||z||; and ||x^dagger bold-dot x|| >= (1-alpha)||x||^2 >= (1-beta)||x||^2. Conjugate-linearity, involutivity, isometry, anti-multiplicativity, both exact unit identities, J^dagger=J, and ||J||=1 are parameter-free axioms and remain unchanged.
